aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.subtitle: Preserving Thai Heritage Through Exquisite Craftsmanship
aboutUs.intro: Welcome to กรุช่างไทย (Gru Chang Thai), where the timeless art of Thai craftsmanship meets contemporary elegance. We are dedicated to preserving and celebrating Thailand's rich cultural heritage through our collection of authentic antique jewelry and handcrafted treasures.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.content: Founded with a passion for Thai cultural preservation, กรุช่างไทย has been a guardian of traditional craftsmanship for generations. Our journey began with a simple mission: to honor the skilled artisans who have shaped Thailand's artistic legacy and to share their exceptional work with the world.

craftsmanship.title: Master Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.content: Each piece in our collection represents hours of meticulous work by master craftsmen who have inherited techniques passed down through generations. From intricate gold work to delicate gem setting, every item tells a story of dedication, skill, and cultural pride.

heritage.title: Cultural Heritage
heritage.content: We believe that authentic Thai antiques and traditional jewelry are more than just beautiful objects – they are vessels of history, culture, and artistic expression. Our curated collection showcases the evolution of Thai design, from ancient royal influences to regional artistic traditions.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To bridge the gap between Thailand's glorious past and its vibrant future by offering carefully selected antique pieces and contemporary interpretations of classical designs. We are committed to supporting local artisans and preserving traditional techniques for future generations.

authenticity.title: Authenticity
authenticity.description: Every piece is carefully verified for its historical significance and craftsmanship quality.

heritage.title: Heritage Preservation
heritage.description: We are committed to preserving Thai cultural traditions and supporting local artisans.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.description: We maintain the highest standards in both our products and customer service.

respect.title: Cultural Respect
respect.description: We honor the cultural significance and sacred nature of traditional Thai art forms.
